statement: Let \(x, y\) be integers with \(x, y \neq -1\) such that \(\dfrac{x^4-1}{y+1} + \dfrac{y^4-1}{x+1} \in \mathbb{Z}\). Prove that \(x^4 y^{44} - 1\) is divisible by \(x+1\).

Let \(B, C\) be fixed points and \(A\) a variable point. Let \(H\) and \(G\) be the orthocenter and centroid of triangle \(ABC\). Given that the midpoint of \(HG\) lies on \(BC\), find the locus of \(A\).

Given a regular 2007-gon. Find the minimal number \(k\) such that among every \(k\) vertices of the polygon, there always exist 4 vertices forming a convex quadrilateral with at least 3 sides also being sides of the polygon.

Given \(b > 0\), find all functions \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) such that
\[f(x+y) = f(x) \cdot 3^{b^y + f(y) - 1} + b^x \cdot \left(3^{b^y + f(y) - 1} - b^y\right)\]
for all \(x, y \in \mathbb{R}\).

Let \(ABCD\) be a trapezoid inscribed in circle \((O)\) with larger base \(BC\). Let \(P\) be a point outside segment \(BC\). Line \(PA\) meets \((O)\) at \(M\) (\(PA\) not tangent to \((O)\)). The circle with diameter \(PD\) meets \((O)\) at \(E\); line \(DE\) meets \(BC\) at \(N\). Prove that \(MN\) always passes through a fixed point.
